fields.label: Token Budget Per Question

fields.description: Hard cap applied to every result, after permissions.
fields.label: Max Rows Returned

fields.description:
Off: a pipeline naming a column the viewer cannot read has that column dropped. On: it raises. Either way the column is never returned.

There is deliberately no switch here for user permissions themselves. They are injected by the resolver that builds every pipeline, so turning them off is not a setting - it would be a different program.
fields.label: Fail On Unreadable Columns
